machine_start_gcode:
SET_PRINT_AUTO_BED_LEVELING ENABLE=1
SET_TIME_LAPSE_CAMERA ENABLE=1
;===== Mnemonic3d - MULTIACE MOD =====================

PRINT_START
DEFECT_DETECTION_START
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER={total_layer_count}
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO CURRENT_LAYER=0
TIMELAPSE_START

;===== Initial heating ========
M140 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single}
M104 T{initial_extruder} S150
M204 S10000

;===== XY homing ========
G28 X Y

;===== Bed foreign-object detection ========
T{initial_extruder}
G90
DEFECT_DETECTION_DETECT_BED

;===== Toolhead pickup/drop detection ========
SM_PRINT_CHECK_SWITCH_EXTRUDER

;===========================================================
; MultiACE FILAMENT CONTROL
;
; SM_PRINT_AUTO_FEED intentionally removed.
; SM_PRINT_FLOW_CALIBRATE intentionally removed.
; SM_PRINT_EXTRUDER_PREHEAT intentionally removed.
;
; MultiACE Web Preflight handles the required ACE/head/slot
; loading before the starting-line section.
;
; The active nozzle remains at or above 150C throughout
; startup, cleaning, homing, and bed leveling.
;===========================================================

;===== Prepare active nozzle ========
T{initial_extruder}
M104 T{initial_extruder} S{max(nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90, 150)}

;===== Rough homing ========
M106 S255
M106 P2 S0

MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION

M109 T{initial_extruder} S{max(nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 70, 150)}

ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_WITH_DISCARD
MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER

G28 Z I140 J140

;===== Build plate detection ========
DETECT_BED_PLATE

;===== Deep nozzle cleaning ========
G90
G0 Z5 F10000

MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION

M109 T{initial_extruder} S{max(nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 50, 150)}

ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE
MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER
FINELY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_STAGE_1

M104 T{initial_extruder} S{max(nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90, 150)}

G0 Z5 F10000
MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION

ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE
MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER
FINELY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_STAGE_2

;===== Final nozzle wipe before precision homing ========
G90
G0 Z5 F10000

MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION
ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE

MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER

;===== Precision homing ========
M106 S255

M109 T{initial_extruder} S{max(nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90, 150)}

M190 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single}

M107 P2

G90
G0 Z5 F10000

G28 Z

;===== Bed leveling ========
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE mesh_min={adaptive_bed_mesh_min[0]},{adaptive_bed_mesh_min[1]} mesh_max={adaptive_bed_mesh_max[0]},{adaptive_bed_mesh_max[1]} ALGORITHM=[bed_mesh_algo] PROBE_COUNT={bed_mesh_probe_count[0]},{bed_mesh_probe_count[1]} ADAPTIVE=0 ADAPTIVE_MARGIN=0

;===== Draw the starting line ========
; MultiACE Web Preflight inserts the required initial
; ACE/head/slot load immediately before this section.

G90
G1 Z1.5
G0 X10 Y3 Z2 F18000

;===== Heat mapped printing tool to actual first-layer temp ========
T{initial_extruder}
M109 T{initial_extruder} S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]}

;===== Purge line ========
G1 Z0.2
M83
G1 X110 E15 F360
G1 Z1.5

;===== Start print ========
G90
M106 S0
name: Snapmaker U1 MultiACE (0.6 nozzle)
